_comment: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) and adjust. The runner (scripts/run_book.py) reads it; Claude Code driving SKILL.md by hand does not need it.
_base_url_note: OpenAI-compatible root. NVIDIA NIM is the default (free tier, nvapi- key). Swap for a local server, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama) or http://localhost:8000/v1 (vLLM).
_model_note: Beefy Qwen on NIM — strongest in-list discipline, writes simple by default (good for graded readers; the validator is the floor either way). For more literary prose try 'moonshotai/kimi-k2-instruct' (most natural per the HSK-story benchmark) or 'zai-org/glm-4.6'. One-line swap; the prompts are model-agnostic.
_api_key_file_note: Path (relative to the skill dir) to a gitignored file holding ONLY the key. Create secrets/nim.key and paste your nvapi-... key. Never commit the key.
_api_key_env_note: Fallback: if the key file is absent, read this environment variable instead.
